scripts.wasm:build: cd wasm-md-core && wasm-pack build --target web --release && mkdir -p ../wasm-md-web/src/wasm ../wasm-md-web/public/wasm && cp pkg/wasm_md_core.js ../wasm-md-web/src/wasm/ && cp pkg/wasm_md_core.d.ts ../wasm-md-web/src/wasm/ && cp pkg/wasm_md_core_bg.wasm ../wasm-md-web/public/wasm/ && sed -i "s|module_or_path = new URL('wasm_md_core_bg.wasm', import.meta.url);|throw new Error('wasm_md_core: WASM path must be specified');|g" ../wasm-md-web/src/wasm/wasm_md_core.js
scripts.dev: npm run wasm:build && npm run web:dev
